method: Read882 additional lines of input, destruction, settings reload and execution entry; static callgraph/ownership review only.
findings: execute_selected checks results_stale first, kills debounce, triggers fresh search and returns. Thus old rows are not blindly executed after normal query edit; this narrows prior stale-result risk. Same-id late-fast replacement remains a separate issue because receiver marks results current.

Plugin execution is checked before general action dispatch; phone sync special case precedes that check. Full plugin_execution_allowed implementation remains unread; no global permission bypass inference.

Filter change clamps scroll offset but not selected index when nonempty smaller result set; execute_selected uses get(selected), safely yielding no action if out of range. Keyboard selected-row usability needs UI fixture, not memory-safety failure claim.

Result mouse hit-testing checks row y range but no x range in reviewed row loop; hover similarly uses y only. Clicks outside launcher content width could select a row if within receiving window. Actual client geometry/hit routing needs Windows test.

WM_DESTROY clears userdata before freeing State and destroys many fonts/icons and thumbnail objects. No destruction appears there for icon_phone_connect, icon_agent or icon_agent_chat declared/loaded earlier; class/tray icon ownership also needs separate qualification. No GDI leak counters measured.

WM_RELOAD_SETTINGS loads AppSettings directly, replaces fonts and watcher, re-registers hotkey; no item_height zero validation appears. Together with direct startup and visible_results division, invalid-config crash mechanism remains source-supported but not integrated reproduced.

Reload updates homepage only when query empty; nonempty-query result list is not re-searched in this handler. Plugin execution has a later check, so stale display is not proof disabled actions execute.
AI input length threshold tests bytes but truncates by chars, so multibyte input over30000 bytes can remain above that byte budget. No endpoint request made.
Reopening stored chat always sets ai_pending false and displays stored response; comment about reconnecting active runs not demonstrated by this branch. Other runtime reconciliation remains unread.
limits: No new tests, UI actions or local production changes.
